Cerium/cerium (cerium anomaly) =[Ce(ch)]/[La(ch)^0.5*Pr(ch)^0.5], where Ce(ch), La(ch), and Pr(ch) are chondrite normalized according to the chondrite values of McDonough and Sun (1995): Ce(ch)=Ce(ppm)/0.613; La(ch)=La(ppm)/0.237; Pr(ch)=Pr(ppm)/0.0928
